Review the content and scope before saving. Maximum 1024 characters; expires in 180 days. Do not enter passwords, API keys or private keys. When memory is enabled, relevant notes are sent with your question to your selected AI provider.
Enter 1–1024 characters. Content is never silently shortened.
Not saved: the content may contain credentials, or memory capacity is full. Edit the content or remove unused memories.
It will no longer be used in future questions. Content already sent to AI and chat history will not be recalled or erased.
These memories were selected for the latest request; delivery is not guaranteed. Later edits or deletions do not change that request.
Encrypted memory requires Android 6.0 or newer. This device will not save memory in plaintext.
